# acme extract
# source: embedded
# type: cli-contracts/command-extract
---
source: embedded
type: cli-contracts/command-extract
extractedAt: <TIME>
spec_version: 0.1.0
commands:
  - acme.users
  - acme.users.import
  - acme.users.remove
  - acme.config.get
  - acme.config.set
  - acme.db.migrate.up
  - acme.ask
---
cli_contracts: 0.1.0

info:
  title: Acme CLI
  version: 2.3.1
  description: Conformance contract with nested groups, effects and an LLM command.

artifact_slots:
  users-db:
    description: The user directory.
    direction: readwrite

command_sets:
  acme:
    executable: acme
    summary: Manage users, configuration and deployments of the Acme service.
    env:
      ACME_TOKEN:
        description: API token.
        sensitive: true
      ACME_LOG:
        description: Log level.
    groups:
      config:
        description: Read and write configuration values.
      db.migrate:
        summary: Schema migrations.
    global_options:
      - name: verbose
        aliases: [v]
        description: Print diagnostic output.
        schema:
          type: boolean
          default: false
      - name: profile
        value_name: name
        description: Configuration profile to use.
        schema:
          type: string
          default: default
      - name: log-file
        value_name: path
        description: Write a log to this file.
        schema:
          type: string
        file:
          mode: append

    commands:
      users:
        summary: Show a summary of all users.
        options:
          - name: all
            aliases: [a]
            description: Include deactivated users.
            schema:
              type: boolean
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Summary written.
            stdout:
              format: json
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserSummary'

      users.import:
        summary: Import users from a file. The file is read once and every row is validated before any user is written, so a failed import leaves the directory unchanged.
        arguments:
          - name: file
            description: CSV file to import.
            required: true
            schema:
              type: string
            file:
              mode: read
        options:
          - name: dry-run
            aliases: [n]
            description: Validate without writing.
            schema:
              type: boolean
          - name: format
            aliases: [f]
            value_name: fmt
            description: Input format.
            schema:
              type: string
              enum: [csv, tsv]
              default: csv
          - name: tag
            aliases: [t]
            value_name: tag
            description: Tag to attach to every imported user.
            repeatable: true
            schema:
              type: string
          - name: color
            description: Colorize the report.
            schema:
              type: boolean
              default: true
          - name: no-cache
            description: Bypass the import cache.
            schema:
              type: boolean
          - name: limit
            value_name: n
            description: Stop after this many rows.
            schema:
              type: integer
          - name: report
            value_name: path
            description: Write a report to this file.
            schema:
              type: string
            file:
              mode: write
          - name: all
            description: Import deactivated users too.
            schema:
              type: boolean
        effects:
          risk_level: medium
          writes:
            - target: user directory
              description: imported users
              idempotent: true
              idempotency_key: email
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Import succeeded.
            stdout:
              format: json
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImportResult'
          '2':
            description: Invalid arguments.
            stderr:
              format: json
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
          '10':
            description: Partial import.
            stdout:
              required: false
              format: json
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImportResult'
            stderr:
              format: json
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'

      users.remove:
        summary: Remove users.
        arguments:
          - name: ids
            description: User IDs.
            required: true
            variadic: true
        options:
          - name: force
            description: Remove without archiving.
            schema:
              type: boolean
            effects:
              risk_level: high
              writes:
                - target: archive
                  destructive: true
        effects:
          risk_level: medium
          requires_confirmation: false
          writes:
            - users-db
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Removed.
          '3':
            description: Some users were not found.

      config.get:
        summary: Print a configuration value.
        arguments:
          - name: key
            description: Configuration key.
            required: true
          - name: fallback
            description: Value printed when the key is not set.
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Value printed.

      config.set:
        summary: Set a configuration value.
        arguments:
          - name: key
            required: true
          - name: value
            required: true
        effects:
          reads:
            - target: configuration file
              description: current values
          writes:
            - target: configuration file
              overwrite: true
              idempotent: true
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Value set.

      db.migrate.up:
        summary: Apply pending migrations.
        options:
          - name: to
            value_name: version
            description: Stop at this version.
            schema:
              type: string
          - name: step
            value_name: n
            description: Number of migrations to apply.
            schema:
              type: integer
              default: 1
        effects:
          risk_level: high
          network:
            description: database connection
            domains: [db.acme.test]
            idempotent: false
          execution_mode: long-running
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Migrations applied.

      ask:
        summary: Ask the assistant a question about the configuration.
        arguments:
          - name: question
            required: true
        options:
          - name: adapter
            value_name: name
            description: LLM adapter to use.
            schema:
              type: string
              enum: [claude, openai]
            effects:
              network:
                description: LLM API call
                idempotent: true
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Answer written.
          '12':
            description: LLM provider error.

components:
  schemas:
    UserSummary:
      type: object
      required: [total, active]
      properties:
        total:
          type: integer
        active:
          type: integer
        ratio:
          type: number
        roles:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
    Role:
      type: string
      enum: [admin, member, guest]
    ImportResult:
      type: object
      required: [imported]
      properties:
        imported:
          type: integer
        skipped:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [row]
            properties:
              row:
                type: integer
              reason:
                type: string
        dry-run:
          type: boolean
        meta:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
    Error:
      type: object
      required: [code, message]
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
        message:
          type: string
        details:
          oneOf:
            - type: string
            - type: object
              additionalProperties: true
    AuditedImport:
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImportResult'
        - type: object
          required: [auditor]
          properties:
            auditor:
              type: string

        description: Log level.

      config:
        description: Read and write configuration values.
      db.migrate:
        summary: Schema migrations.
    global_options:
      - name: verbose
        aliases: [v]
        description: Print diagnostic output.
        schema:
          type: boolean
          default: false
      - name: profile
        value_name: name
        description: Configuration profile to use.
        schema:
          type: string
          default: default
      - name: log-file
        value_name: path
        description: Write a log to this file.
        schema:
          type: string
        file:
          mode: append

    commands:
      users:
        summary: Show a summary of all users.
        options:
          - name: all
            aliases: [a]
            description: Include deactivated users.
            schema:
              type: boolean
        exits:

            description: Summary written.

              format: json
              schema:

        arguments:
          - name: file
            description: CSV file to import.
            required: true
            schema:
              type: string
            file:
              mode: read
        options:
          - name: dry-run
            aliases: [n]
            description: Validate without writing.
            schema:
              type: boolean
          - name: format
            aliases: [f]
            value_name: fmt
            description: Input format.
            schema:
              type: string
              enum: [csv, tsv]
              default: csv
          - name: tag
            aliases: [t]
            value_name: tag
            description: Tag to attach to every imported user.
            repeatable: true
            schema:
              type: string
          - name: color
            description: Colorize the report.
            schema:
              type: boolean
              default: true
          - name: no-cache
            description: Bypass the import cache.
            schema:
              type: boolean
          - name: limit
            value_name: n
            description: Stop after this many rows.
            schema:
              type: integer
          - name: report
            value_name: path
            description: Write a report to this file.
            schema:
              type: string
            file:
              mode: write
          - name: all
            description: Import deactivated users too.
            schema:
              type: boolean
        effects:
          risk_level: medium
          writes:
            - target: user directory
              description: imported users

              idempotency_key: email

            stdout:
              format: json
              schema:

            stderr:
              format: json
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'

            stdout:

              format: json
              schema:

              format: json

        summary: Print a configuration value.
        arguments:
          - name: key
            description: Configuration key.
            required: true
          - name: fallback
            description: Value printed when the key is not set.

          '0':
            description: Value printed.

        summary: Set a configuration value.
        arguments:
          - name: key
            required: true
          - name: value
            required: true
        effects:
          reads:
            - target: configuration file
              description: current values
          writes:
            - target: configuration file
              overwrite: true
              idempotent: true
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Value set.

            value_name: n

            schema:
              type: integer

        effects:
          risk_level: high
          network:
            description: database connection
            domains: [db.acme.test]
            idempotent: false
          execution_mode: long-running
        exits:
          '0':

        summary: Ask the assistant a question about the configuration.
        arguments:
          - name: question
            required: true
        options:
          - name: adapter
            value_name: name
            description: LLM adapter to use.
            schema:
              type: string
              enum: [claude, openai]
            effects:
              network:
                description: LLM API call
                idempotent: true
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Answer written.
          '12':
            description: LLM provider error.

        value_name: path
        description: Write a log to this file.
        schema:

        options:
          - name: all

            stdout:

              schema:

            stderr:

            required: true
          - name: value
            required: true
        effects:

            - target: configuration file
              description: current values
          writes:
            - target: configuration file
              overwrite: true
              idempotent: true
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Value set.

          execution_mode: long-running
        exits:

        arguments:
          - name: question
            required: true
        options:
          - name: adapter
            value_name: name
            description: LLM adapter to use.
            schema:
              type: string
              enum: [claude, openai]
            effects:
              network:
                description: LLM API call
                idempotent: true
        exits:
          '0':
            description: Answer written.
          '12':
            description: LLM provider error.
